model.name: Identity merge cleans up room membership (no ghost members)
model.description: When profiles are merged (Link Account / consolidate, leaving the target tombstoned with redirectTo set), the merge MUST clean up room membership so a tombstoned profile never appears as a ghost member: a room shows exactly ONE canonical member per merged identity. Link Account MUST succeed when the secret code is correct, and the flow MUST NOT create a phantom empty profile.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "in the heartspaces are 2 marcel donges users. i tried to link accounts but it did not work though my secret number was correct."

acceptanceCriteria.text: After a merge, tombstoned profiles (redirectTo set) are removed/redirected from every room member list - no duplicate ghost member.
A room with merged identities shows exactly ONE canonical member per person (Heartspaces shows one Marcel Donges, not two).
Link Account / consolidate SUCCEEDS when the entered secret code matches the target's secretCode.
A correct secret code never yields a silent failure; a wrong code yields an explicit CONSOLIDATE_FAILED 'Wrong secret code'.
The identity/link flow does NOT create a phantom empty/uncommitted profile (e.g. the observed 6a27140d).
Existing ghost members from past merges are reconciled (cleanup is retroactive for already-tombstoned profiles in rooms).
Verified live (headless) in a real room: merge 2+ profiles, the room member list collapses to one canonical member.

discoveryContext.observed: Heartspaces room shows 2 'Marcel Donges' after merging 3 profiles into 1; Link Account failed despite correct secret code; phantom empty profile 6a27140d created.
discoveryContext.mechanism: CONSOLIDATE handler server.ts:2037 sets redirectTo tombstone but does not clean room membership; empty-profile create at server.ts:1980.
